VBO:0200728.summary: At five months, Prince loved play at home and greeted returning people with a bark and a jump in Greenleaf Animal Rescue’s account. Owner Mark Skinner described a two-year-old Jackador enjoying runs and repeated ball games in a secure field. Jackador names a Jack Russell Terrier–Labrador Retriever cross.
